subject: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics
messages:
From: Elena Garcia <elena@eventive.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eventive Partnerships <partners@eventive.io>
Date: 2026-10-04T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well (hi from Austin!). Eventive is putting together a small series of partner-led regional retreats (SF, Austin, NYC) in Q1 2027 focused on practitioner workshops + customer roundtables. We think Redwood would be a perfect strategic partner for content and demo support.

Quick overview: three single-day events, expected audience ~120-200 qualified product/engineering leaders per market, pre-event webinar to seed interest, on-site shared booth space and two breakouts (one product demo / one technical deep dive).

Ask: Eventive requests MDF to help cover venue, registration platform, and a joint paid spend push. Ballpark MDF request is $60k per market (Eventive covers logistics + vendor fees).

Would Redwood consider a joint funding model? If you're open, we'd like to propose a 60/40 split (Redwood 60%, Eventive 40%) and get a short MOU in place. Next steps from our side: share vendor list and a draft MOU; from your side: confirm interest, attendee profile needs, and preferred dates in Feb - March.

Proposed call week of Oct 11 to run through audience, KPIs, and MDF mechanics.

Attaching: vendor list (CSV) and a short one-pager on the retreat format (will send separately).

Thanks,
Elena Garcia
Head of Partnerships, Eventive Events
elena@eventive.io
+1 512-555-0189
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@eventive.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics

Hi Elena,

Really interesting — thanks for the overview. We're definitely interested in a shoulder-season partner program like this. A few quick asks before we commit to MDF:

- Can you share the attendee persona and expected conversion benchmarks (leads -> SQLs) by market?
- Do you have a line-item budget for the $60k per market ask (venue, paid, registration, vendor fees)?
- Suggested dates: Feb 8 (SF), Feb 22 (Austin), Mar 8 (NYC), are those flexible?

Internally I've looped in Monica (marketing ops) and Sergio (commercial) to iron out funding and staffing. I can commit to getting an internal decision on a conditional MDF contribution by Oct 15 if we have the budget breakdown and KPIs.

Happy to take the Oct 11 call, please propose a time and we'll confirm.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Director, GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics

Rachel / Monica,

Looping in my quick commercial take. If Eventive's total per-market spend is ~$100k, a 60/40 approach where Redwood takes 60% (~$60k) is aggressive but doable for strategic pipeline markets. Conditions I'd attach:

- Lead guarantees (min 60 SQLs per market) or a mutually agreed SLA on lead quality;
- Joint owned MQL -> SQL tracking in HubSpot (we need HubSpot event pipeline visibility);
- A short-term performance clawback clause in the MOU (reduce MDF if lead benchmarks not hit).

If the above is acceptable I can push a $60k per-market reserved line, but need Monica to confirm staffing and marketing ops costs (webinars, paid) and legal to review MOU.

Also tagging procurement for vendor terms / invoicing cadence will be needed once we sign.

Sergio
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics

Thanks Elena (and team), and thanks Rachel for the loop.

I've drafted a short MOU (attached) that covers the funding split, lead KPIs, payment schedule (50% deposit / 50% 30 days post-event), and a simple performance clawback tied to SQL counts. Also attached: booth staffing plan (we're recommending 2 Redwood AEs + 1 SE on-site per market, and 1 on-call Solutions Engineer for the technical breakout).

Operational notes:
- Pre-event webinar (4 weeks prior) to seed registrants; Redwood to provide content + one product presenter.
- Paid social + LinkedIn: joint budget line item, we'd like creative assets 6 weeks prior.
- Travel: we estimate ~$6k per market for travel/hotel for booth staff (included in MDF ask).

Links: planning doc + calendar draft are here: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/retreat-planning/rdw-eventive

Next steps: Elena please confirm the attendee persona + vendor list. Rachel if we're aligned on $60k / market and the MOU terms I'll route to legal and finance for approval this week.

Attachments: Draft_MOU_Eventive_Redwood_v1.pdf; BoothStaffingPlan.xlsx

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Field & Events
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Garcia <elena@eventive.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Retreat Series & Field Sprint: MDF split and logistics

Hi all,

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming: Eventive is good with the 60/40 funding model and the draft MOU structure. I've attached our vendor list and a simple budget breakdown for each market (CSV).

We'll also lock tentative dates as Rachel suggested: SF Feb 8, Austin Feb 22, NYC Mar 8. We'll prepare the pre-event webinar dates and share creative deadlines next week.

Proposed next step: sign the attached MOU in principle and set a 30-minute alignment call Oct 12 at 10:00am PT to confirm KPIs and invoicing cadence.

Attaching: vendor_list_eventive.csv

Thanks and looking forward,
Elena
